name: agent-hover
description: Point at your UI. Your agent understands it.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:overlay && npm run build:vite && npm run build:mcp && npm run build:cli
scripts.sync:license: for d in core overlay vite mcp cli; do cp LICENSE packages/$d/; done
scripts.typecheck: for d in core overlay vite mcp cli; do tsc --noEmit -p packages/$d/tsconfig.json || exit 1; done
scripts.screenshots: AH_SCREENSHOTS=1 node scripts/e2e-isolated.mjs e2e/v02-main-flow.spec.ts e2e/v02-verify.spec.ts e2e/v02-dock-sidebar.spec.ts e2e/v02-screenshots-update.spec.ts
